author: Jacob Sussman
about: Machine-readable index of the E8 result of the fourth revision: figures, files, checksums, theorem names, which program reproduces what, and which approach reached which figure. The account in words is in how-the-e8-unit-was-found.md, what-did-not-work.md and open-directions-2.md, in this folder.

how_to_read.figure: A figure is a saving 1 - z. figure_integer N means the exponent z = 1 - N/10^10; saving is the same number in the form 8.7625e-4.

status_values.lean: a theorem of this repository, checked by Lean's kernel
status_values.lean_during_the_work: built and checked in Lean on 2026-10-10 under a working name; the Lean files of that design are not included in this repository
status_values.price: computed by tools/gx/refcheck.py and tools/gx/gxdry.py for a certificate file that both accept; not checked in Lean in this repository
status_values.what_if: arithmetic with no design behind it
status_values.on_paper: argued in writing by the AI agents of this project with computer checks; not in Lean, without a human review

how_to_read.review: The reports behind this index were written by AI agents (Claude) that I directed, on 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-10. They have not had a line-by-line human review.
